description: Diagnostic (not causal): association of NHTSA's imputed BAC >= .08 with the driver being killed among untested FARS drivers, compared with tested drivers, adjusted for age band, sex, vehicle type, crash type, time of day and year
population: FARS drivers (PER_TYP 1) 2016-2024 with known survival status and an NHTSA-imputed BAC probability, split into untested (imputed) and tested (measured BAC)
outcome: driver killed; OR for imputed/measured BAC >= .08 (p08 = 1 vs 0)
method: Logistic regression of killed on p08 plus covariates, cluster-robust CI, no sampling weights; group x p08 interaction gives the ratio of ORs; diagnostic, not causal
